title: runPersonaTest orchestrator (observe → decide → act loop, event log)
acceptance: packages/runner/src/run-persona-test.ts: runPersonaTest({ runId, personaProfile, config, decisionProvider, browser }) → { stopReason, eventCount }

Loop: open URL → snapshot → DecisionProvider.decide → safety.checkAction → execute via browser → screenshot → log RunEvent → stop on (action.type==='stop' | maxActions | maxDurationSec | safety_violation)
Each step writes one RunEvent to events.ndjson under .personabench/runs/<runId>/
stopReason ∈ {success, dropoff, blocked, timeout, action_limit, safety_violation, payment_blocked}
Tests: drive the loop with MockDecisionProvider + a fake AgentBrowserSession; verify event log shape, max-action stop, max-duration stop, safety stop
